releaseVersion.policy: Marketing version is shared across platforms. Every submitted binary must monotonically increase the platform build number/version code; marketing version changes are explicit release decisions.

dataFlowEvidence.healthClassificationBasis: User-provided skin profile, sensitivity, concern and skin-diary state are treated as health-related data for privacy disclosure; this classification is not a diagnostic or medical-product claim.

exportCompliance.basis: Mobile-owned networking is standard HTTPS; auth session protection uses Expo SecureStore and Apple platform keychain facilities; no app-owned non-exempt cryptography dependency was observed in the mobile/shared dependency surface.

mobile20StoreCaptureContract.validationPolicy: Any new candidate head invalidates prior exact-head screenshot approval. Final release authority requires fresh exact-head artifact visual review and a separate merged-main artifact visual review.

complianceInventory.reason: Public Korean/English privacy-policy routes are deployed on the canonical production origin; the public privacy contact value remains external authority.
The authenticated mobile My flow exposes Privacy · Account and hard account deletion; Sign in with Apple deletion fails closed until Apple token-revocation credentials are configured.

The public web deletion resource is deployed and reachable on the canonical production origin; the provider-neutral request contact must still be configured before Play Console metadata can claim completion.
The iOS client implements native Sign in with Apple and Supabase Apple ID-token exchange. Apple Developer/Supabase provider authority remains external and must be verified before store submission.

Expo now freezes opaque 1024x1024 BEJEWELY root/Android and iOS light/dark production icons plus a 512x512 Google Play listing icon derived from the audited brand artwork. A custom Android adaptive foreground/monochrome layer is not configured; android.icon remains the launcher fallback and adaptive-layer optimization is non-blocking.

The 512x512 listing icon is repository-frozen, the deterministic bilingual 1080x1920 Home/Analyze/Results/Diary repository capture set is visually qualified by MOBILE-20A/MOBILE-20B, and the Google Play 1024x500 feature graphic is repository-qualified by MOBILE-20C. App Store screenshot submission packaging remains repository-pending; support-contact configuration, App Store Connect metadata, and Google Play Console metadata remain external.

App-owned collected-data types, tracking=false and observed required-reason categories are source-frozen in Expo config and checked after iOS prebuild; final App Store upload validation remains external.

The repository now freezes the minimum collected-data inventory, required/optional handling, purposes, service-provider sharing boundary, deletion mechanism and production HTTPS transport contract; Play Console submission and processor/ZDR authority remain external.

The repository freezes the conservative Google Play Health Apps declaration basis for skin care, explicitly keeps Medical Device Apps unselected, preserves cosmetic/non-diagnostic product boundaries, and freezes any policy disclaimer to Play store-description metadata rather than runtime analysis UI. Play Console submission and review remain external.
The source declares ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption=false from the audited exempt-only mobile cryptography boundary; App Store Connect confirmation remains external.

The repository freezes the current Apple age-rating and Google IARC questionnaire answer basis, while final store-calculated ratings, App Store Connect/Play Console submission, and Google Target Audience & Content remain external.

The repository now freezes allowed cosmetic skin-care positioning and prohibits diagnostic, treatment, clinical-accuracy, medical-device and guaranteed-efficacy claims in final store metadata. The existing MOBILE-16D Play-description disclaimer remains store-only; final title/description/promotional copy and remaining non-screenshot store assets still require review before submission.

passMeans: MOBILE-13 release-preflight identity, toolchain, permission and native build contracts remain preserved.
MOBILE-14 native Apple auth, Universal Links, Android Verified App Links and hosted association boundaries remain preserved.
MOBILE-15 freezes a secret-safe distribution authority contract and exact-SHA manual signed-artifact workflow.

MOBILE-16A source-freezes public privacy/deletion routes, in-app account deletion, direct and linked customer-data purge, provider-neutral external deletion request, and fail-closed Sign in with Apple token revocation; its public routes are deployed on the canonical production origin.

MOBILE-16B source-freezes the app-owned Apple collected-data inventory, tracking=false boundary, observed required-reason API declarations and Expo exempt-only export-compliance declaration, with generated PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy and Info.plist verification.

MOBILE-16C source-freezes the Google Play Data Safety answer basis and enforces HTTPS for production mobile API and Supabase traffic while preserving explicit external Play Console, processor-contract and OpenAI ZDR authority boundaries.

MOBILE-16D source-freezes a conservative Google Play Health Apps declaration for the skin-care taxonomy, keeps medical-device/diagnosis/treatment claims false, and keeps policy disclaimer copy in Play store-description metadata rather than runtime analysis UI.

MOBILE-16E source-freezes the Apple age-rating and Google IARC questionnaire answer basis, including health/wellness versus medical-treatment separation and the absence of in-app social/UGC exchange, while leaving final store ratings external.

MOBILE-16F source-freezes the store-listing claim boundary: cosmetic personalization is allowed, while diagnosis, treatment, medical-device, clinical-accuracy and guaranteed-efficacy claims are prohibited; no runtime medical disclaimer is added.
Android upload signing is separated from the Google Play delivered app-signing certificate used by Verified App Links.
iOS distribution certificate, App Store provisioning profile, Apple token-revocation credentials and export-options authority are injected only at workflow/runtime authority boundaries.
Missing distribution or Apple revocation credentials fail closed rather than silently claiming store readiness.
Known store compliance and external-authority blockers remain explicit and fail-visible.

MOBILE-16H source-freezes BEJEWELY production launcher icons (root/Android and iOS light/dark) plus the 512x512 Google Play listing icon from audited opaque brand artwork; a custom Android adaptive-layer asset remains a non-blocking optimization.

MOBILE-20A and MOBILE-20B provide deterministic bilingual 1080x1920 repository capture contracts for Home, Analyze, Results and signed-in Diary; every candidate head and merged-main release authority still requires its own fresh artifact and direct visual review.
